name: linux-install
body: Linux users install kalide by downloading the `kalide-linux-<arch>` asset directly (anonymously, no token) from the public GitHub Release of really-knows-ai/kalide (no Homebrew/Scoop-equivalent tap or bucket), making it executable (`chmod +x kalide-linux-<arch>`), and running it. The same manual download is the fallback route for macOS and Windows. AC: on a clean Linux machine of a supported arch with no GitHub credentials, downloading the release asset (e.g. with `curl -L` on the public release URL), chmod +x, and running it starts kalide successfully.
